[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

Report Generated: [[REPORT_DATE]]

2. Start & End Date

Run Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

Run End Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

Overview of Automated Workflow:

  1. Manual Preparation:
    • Pause step executed with instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • Operator fills the ÄKTA sample loop with the prepared sample according to the experimental plan.
  2. ÄKTA Pure - Automated Chromatography Run:
    • ÄKTA Pure system started using a predefined method controlling column loading, washing, elution, and cleaning-in-place (CIP) phases.
    • System recorded UV signal (uv1) and conductivity (cond) throughout the run at 1 s sampling intervals.
Run Parameters
Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Identifier of the automated ÄKTA process.
Equilibration Duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Time used to equilibrate the column before loading.
Equilibration Flow Rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate applied during column equilibration.
Load/Inject Duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Total time used for sample loading/injection.
Load/Inject Flow Rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during sample loading/injection.
Wash Duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of post-load column washing.
Wash Flow Rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during wash phase.
Elution Gradient Duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total time of the elution gradient.
Elution Gradient Start (%B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting buffer B percentage for the gradient.
Elution Gradient End (%B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final buffer B percentage at the end of the gradient.
CIP Duration (overall) [[CIP_DURATION]] Total duration of column cleaning-in-place procedure.
CIP Step 2 Hold Duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during CIP step 2.
CIP Step 3 Duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 3.
CIP Step 4 Duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 4.
CIP Step 5 Duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 5.
